newsitem.title: USA: INTERVIEW - Western Asset lightens corporate bonds.
newsitem.headline: INTERVIEW - Western Asset lightens corporate bonds.

text.p: A richly valued corporate bond market and longer-term outlook for wider spreads prompted Western Asset Management Co to assemble a $1.44 billion sell list on Tuesday, said Chief Investment Officer Kent Engel.

"The corporate bond market has done exceeding well over the past few years, spreads are at historical tights, and we felt the risk reward profile of the market warranted lightening up a little bit," Engel told Reuters.
Western sees the U.S. Treasury market as a "good alternative" to corporate bonds, he added, based on positive inflation fundamentals and prospects for lower Treasury yields.
